verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents an official CLI and Python SDK covering the whole platform, an end-to-end scripted workflow (search, rent, wait for boot, connect, copy data, clean up), and a REST API backed by a probe-confirmed OpenAPI spec. Its docs explicitly recommend scoped API keys for CI/CD and automation, so headless operation is a first-class, documented use case. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of CI pipeline use, and no documented CI-specific integration examples (e.g., a GitHub Actions recipe).
